assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the PR-204 denial
Blue Summit Plan states the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats
The patient is prompting further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia
The submitted diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R00.2
The cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances by capturing electrocardiographic data during symptom onset
